description:
There is a sub-registrar in the Vats Registry who has been passing the Watch small true things for four months. This morning she sent one word, which is what they agreed she would send if she thought somebody had noticed.

Cyrelle does not dress it up. She is a clerk with an eleven-year account and about two hours before somebody upstairs reads the same log Cyrelle has just read.

"Get in, get her file off the ledger so there is no paper saying she existed, and walk her out on her feet. She will want to talk on the way. Let her."

Before you go, Cyrelle teaches you the thing every runner learns eventually.

"When she sends, she puts one wrong letter in the third word. Always the third. If a message ever comes in from her spelled correctly, it is not her sending it, and the reply we send goes to whoever is holding her arm."

She lets that sit.

"People have ignored that before. It is how you lose a whole network in a fortnight."

fail_on.desc: The Registry reconciles at shift change. After that she is a discrepancy rather than a colleague, and discrepancies are somebody's job.
She dies once, messily, like anyone else. The only copy of her is in her hands.

Do not kill a Halcyon supervisor. Put one down and this stops being an account dispute and becomes a homicide on Ascendant ground, and everything she carried out stops being evidence and starts being a motive.

name: Retention

objectives.desc: Get into the Registry in the Vats and stand the floor until you are sure it is between rounds.
Pull her file off the Registry ledger so there is no record of her at all.
Find Nine and give her the word.
Walk her out of the Vats.
Hand her and her file over at the Blind.
emotes: {who} puts the file on the counter and a woman beside it, in that order, because that is the order they were asked for.
